item.title: Version 0.26.21
item.description:
이번 업데이트

버그 수정

  • 일부 사용자에서 이전 버전 데이터가 손상되어 앱이 실행되지 않던 문제를 해결했어요

What's new

  • Google Calendar sync
    Bring your Google Calendar meetings into BizCrush automatically.
  • Slack automations
    Send tags and updates straight to your Slack workspace.
  • Sharper voice pickup
    On-device noise handling adapts per moment for clearer transcripts.
  • Steadier live transcript
    Interim text no longer flickers while recording.
  • External mic channel picker
    Pick your input channel on multi-input audio interfaces.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed a rare startup crash tied to the local meeting database.
  • Edited transcript lines now save reliably.
  • Tag automations refresh right after you change them.
  • Integration screen shows a proper loading state.
